text: sorry wrong chat, but this popped up for the first time would you move it to exist in the bottom toolbar as a popover alert instead of right on top of the save button [Image #1]
resolution: Moved the native rebuild approval out of the top-right editor overlay and into the bottom status dock. A highlighted NATIVE READY dock button is now the persistent alert; clicking it opens the same approval controls in a bottom-anchored popover, and Keep working closes the popover without discarding the pending update. The notice now starts collapsed, survives ordinary TypeScript bundle reloads through host-owned hot state, and clears immediately after an approval token is successfully handed to the supervisor so exact-child restart handoff cannot resurrect a stale Applying panel. Updated the focused notice tests and verified the full editor bundle.
